research_question: Can direct non-gradient weight programming infer and retain a reusable previously unprogrammed two-variable causal relationship from bounded action-consequence microfeedback, apply it to unfamiliar opaque entities, retain multiple independent relations and disclose off-family failures? Is there any capability beyond equal-information optimized symbolic factor inference?
hypothesis: Given bounded direct interventions, a compact native numerical relational bank can construct hidden row/column causal-factor values (not a supplied correct table) and transfer predicted outcomes across new action identities; strongest optimized symbolic model may tie and must be treated as a no-unique-advantage outcome.
representation_boundary: Source-only 8x8 binary relation pairs yield three-bit consequence vectors through unknown separable latent factor effects; the XOR separability hypothesis class is SUPPLIED, the hidden factor values and any correct 64-entry effect table are NOT. New factor values are NOT new unsupplied computational primitives, and symbolic parity blocks superiority.

source.action_ids: opaque 64 unique random IDs per world, never reused across worlds
source.relation_values: public 8-valued left and right typed inputs, plus public domain ID
source.source_family: each domain has independent hidden row and column 3-bit effect factors, source observed outcome is XOR of their contributions; oracle only in source module, not learner or controls
source.offfamily_negative: same source family plus unrepresented pair interaction on nonanchor rows/columns; source-open only in development and cannot count as positive transfer

controls.NUMERIC_FACTOR_GROW: 16 signed int32 factor slots per domain, direct-gauge updates from 15 verified anchor row/column interventions; 64 bytes/domain excluding ledger, Python and metadata; fail closed on duplicate/conflicting evidence; snapshot validates replay.
controls.SYMBOLIC_FACTOR_STRONG: independent equal-evidence graph constraint solver with 3-bit XOR offsets; same active intervention and source evidence, without importing numeric learning implementation; exact parity expected.
controls.SYMBOLIC_PASSIVE: strong symbolic graph constraint solver fitted on 15 independently seeded, nonadaptive random pairs/domain at same query budget, honest abstention if disconnected
controls.MEMO_ONLY: opaque action ID -> observed outcome only; no generalized pair algebra, same queries
controls.TRAINED_CONVENTIONAL: not run or used for primary comparison in this source-safe development; fully trained matched baseline required before scientific first-use and cannot be replaced by a weak control

fit: 4 independent domains, 15 distinct legal source calls/domain
complete anchor row+column covers all factors under supplied separability
transfer: 64 unfamiliar action-identity permutation worlds/domain, 64 pair predictions/world, 16384 predictions/arm
offfamily: 16 out-of-hypothesis worlds/domain, 4096 predictions/arm, report confidently wrong and abstentions; never count as success
frozen_decisions.retention: cold restoration and domain-0 prediction parity after fitting all four distinct domains
engineering_thresholds: verified source parity exact for equal-evidence controls
fit world unseen pair accuracy >=95%, zero confident wrong
in-family new-entity transfer accuracy >=95%, zero confident wrong
fully trained strong symbolic may tie (not numerical superiority)
offfamily failures must be disclosed, not tuned away
frozen_decisions.efficiency: report 16xint32 slots/domain only; whole-process latency and RSS superiority UNVERIFIED until independently measured; no 2x claim
frozen_decisions.first_use: requires independently owned original source, fixed stronger controls, trained conventional, matched action/compute, preregistered paired CI, cold interference, cross-platform proof and separate owner authority
